text_simplified: Luqman the Wise began his counsel to his son by forbidding shirk, explaining that it is the gravest of sins, nullifies all deeds, and is equating other than Allah with Allah in any of His rights. He then reminded him of Allah's watchfulness and His encompassing of all things. In this is an alert for parents to raise their children on mindfulness of Allah. Planting this aqeedah in children's hearts strengthens their station of ihsan, especially in an age when devices have spread along with the harmful content they may broadcast.
